title: green bonds / sustainable bonds / sovereign debt | Research Paper | Sovereign green bonds: a catalyst for sustainable debt marke...
summary: This BIS Working Paper (No. 1198) examines whether sovereign green bond issuance catalyzes corporate sustainable bond market development. Using regression and event study analysis on a database of labelled bonds, the authors find that sovereign green bond issuance leads to increased corporate sustainable bond issuance (both number and size), with stronger effects in jurisdictions with stronger climate policies. The paper also documents improvements in green disclosure and verification standards after sovereign debut, and finds evidence of greater liquidity and diminished yield spreads in corporate green bonds—though the liquidity and spread effects are limited to the debut sovereign green bond issue.
